full_judgment: 10. It appears from the materials on record that the disputed land was recorded in the name of Bangladesh Railway. It is the positive case of the Railway that the Government acquired the said land for Railway and handed over possession of the same to the Railway. Accordingly, CS record of right was prepared in the name of Railway. From the CS khatian produced by the appellant it appears that the case land was recorded in khatian No. 16868 in the name of Eastern Bengol State Railway Division under Bharat Samrat. CS khatian has got presumptive value. According to section 103B(5) of the Bengal Tenancy Act every entry in a record of right finally published shall be evidence of the matter referred to in such entry shall be presumed to be correct until it is proved by evidence to be incorrect. The same has got a probative value. We do not find anything in the record, relying on which, it can he said that such presumption has been rebutted.
